notes.title: Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between Announced!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084870/Hidden_Memories_of_The_Gardens_Between/?ref=uploadvr.com

Bend time at will, as childhood best friends Arina and Frendt journey across islands filled with precious mementos from the seminal moments of their time together. Explore a captivating narrative through the lens of virtual reality and solve clever puzzles. Embrace a tale retold in a new light, with twice the content in an illustrious, fully remastered package.

https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3084870/extras/TGBVR_Teaser_Final_V32.gif?t=1749060730

We’re so excited to finally share something we’ve been working on for a long time - Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between is a reimagining of our time-bending puzzle game The Gardens Between rebuilt from the ground up for virtual reality. This isn't just a VR port. It's The Gardens Between as you've never seen it before, with double the content and entirely new ways to interact with Arina and Frendt's story.

Making this game has been a really special continuation of the journey we started all the way back in 2011 with the first prototype of a “Minority Report” inspired time manipulation game. Since then, at least three million  people have played The Gardens Between! Members of our original team have scattered throughout the globe and gone on to be part of making so many incredible games. We’re proud that almost the entire original development team reunited for Hidden Memories in some form, bringing the same care and thoughtfulness that made the game special back into this project along with a wealth of new experience. We’ve also been joined by new contributors who’ve brought fresh perspectives and new ideas to The Gardens Between world.

Here’s what you can expect from Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between:

 A fully VR-native experience: We've completely transformed how you interact with the world. Reach out and physically manipulate time itself.
 A new story: Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between begins two decades after the original story, as Frendt is in the midst of moving. Upon discovering the diary of his childhood best friend, Arina, Frendt is transported back to The Gardens Between, now guided by Arina’s treasured diary.
 Over 40 new puzzles: Handcrafted VR-native puzzles scattered across the levels, offering tangible and immersive interactions only possible in VR. Engage in bespoke puzzles delivering unparalleled emotional depth with real-time physics. Reach out and assemble toy parts, lift a paintbrush to experience a whimsical moment, or playfully craft a friendship bracelet to become part of this intimate world.


Watch our reveal trailer here for a look at how we’ve transformed the world for VR:

[previewyoutube=BhfYwF5ApAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hidden Memories of The Gardens Between is coming soon to Steam VR and Meta Quest Store. Whether you're a longtime fan or completely new to the game, we can't wait for you to experience this magical journey in a whole new dimension.

Wishlist now to be notified when Hidden Memories becomes available: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084870/Hidden_Memories_of_The_Gardens_Between/?ref=uploadvr.com

notes.title: NEW: Previously unreleased music from the Gardens Between out now!
notes.content:
Glowing Pains: Deep Cuts - the second volume of the official soundtrack to The Gardens Between, made by the game’s musician Tim Shiel, is out now!

Stream or purchase on Apple Music, Spotify, iTunes, Deezer, Bandcamp.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27924819/403995066f52fe0d7f774d59d98531fbf698bc32.jpg

The artist Tim Shiel shared some thoughts about the origins of this album:


‘Deep Cuts’ create the scars that you later cherish from things that might have hurt when you were a kid.  Like when you had to say goodbye to that friend, it hurt but now that scar doesn't really hurt any more. It’s just a reminder of something that meant a lot to you.

It’s also a subtle reference to a famous song - "the first cut is the deepest" - which is in reference to someone's first love, first heartbreak. But could also refer to those pains / memories you have from childhood - your first 'loss' of a friend hurts the most (but it’s something that shapes you/that maybe you cherish).

The album was made by taking the sounds from inside the game and then asking 20+ of my friends from around the world to improvise new parts, build on what was there.

I then took all of their parts and reshaped it into a seamless narrative of music that (I hope) reflects on the themes of the game - childhood, memory, loss, hope, friendship.



The Gardens Between soundtrack - Volume One
Tim has recently released a very limited run of the first volume on vinyl - only 500 copies. In true retro style you can now spin the vinyl at your next house party! You can purchase one of the 500 pressings on Tim's Bandcamp page or Vinyl Me Please!

We got our hands on a copy of the vinyl, and it’s as beautiful as the game that inspired it <3 Check out that transparent vinyl print. Gorgeous! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27924819/49d917347345b3af741702800724a23b0c2f2c81.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27924819/856765a90b11931c980f6ace2bfd7255561296e4.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27924819/265c7a164d2a12c4619a71d19a4647ca69480cbc.jpg

If you’re feeling a little more modern you can also stream the music directly on your favourite streaming service. To indulge yourself update The Gardens Between to the latest version and hit the Listen button on the main menu, or follow one of these links below:
